items.title: Earth from Orbit
items.summary: A year of our planet seen from 400 kilometres up — storms turning, coastlines sliding past, city light blooming as the terminator crosses.

items.title: Airglow and the Milky Way
items.summary: The thin band of light at the edge of the atmosphere, photographed against the galaxy from the International Space Station.

items.title: The Multi-coloured Glow
items.summary: Why the upper atmosphere shines in bands of red and green, and what those colours reveal about the air a hundred kilometres overhead.

items.title: The Long Way Around
items.summary: There is a stretch of two lane road east of the coast range where the radio gives out completely. Drivers used to plan for that.

items.title: Notes on Cold Starts
items.summary: The first second of an application is the only second the user did not choose to spend. Everything after that, they opted into.

items.title: Two Processes, One Truth
items.summary: The same state in two places that cannot see each other. Leave a note somewhere they both know about, and tap the other on the shoulder.

items.title: Everything Is a Tradeoff
items.summary: The most useful thing a senior engineer does is not choosing the right answer. It is saying out loud what the other answer would have cost.
